content:
Alex P: Heads-up — I'm planning a thin envelope adapter at the edge to translate v7 client envelopes to our v6 backend shape. Goal is minimal transform and zero client change during a 6mo overlap window. Feedback?
Samir K: 👍 what's the priority — zero-client-change vs runtime perf?
Alex P: Primary is zero-client-change. Perf target: keep added p95 < 10ms for simple text gen requests.
Jordan L: How will this impact prefix/KV caching? Adapter rewriting body often kills cache keys.
Alex P: Plan: avoid touching routing headers and cache-key-related fields. We only rewrite payload envelope keys, e.g. `input` -> `messages[0].text`, and leave `x-rw-cache-key` untouched.
Tina M: Auth — will adapter re-sign or replay tokens? Auth middleware expects tokens shaped a certain way.
Alex P: No token rewrite. Adapter runs after auth validation but before routing. It forwards Authorization header unchanged so existing guards still work.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: branch=thin-envelope-adapter, build=885, env=staging. CI green.
Samir K: We should make it opt-in per-route initially. Some high-throughput routes might want to bypass the adapter entirely.
Jordan L: Add telemetry tags too: `migration.adapter=thin_envelope`, `migration.stage=canary`. Makes it easy to slice metrics.
Alex P: Agreed. Proposed rollout:
1) staging canary (1% of dedicated tenants) for 24h
2) 10% global traffic with opt-in routes listed
3) default-on after 2 weeks if no regressions
Tina M: Error contract — if translation fails, return 409 with header `X-Migration-Hint: translation-failed` so clients can detect and fallback.
Samir K: Tests: need e2e that asserts KV cache hit/miss behavior and streaming chunk integrity. Adapter must not change chunk boundaries for streaming responses.
Alex P: I'll add a harness that simulates prefix caching and streaming sequences. Also adding unit tests for small/large payloads.
Jordan L: Also ensure payload size/limit checks are preserved. No silent chunk recombination that hides large-payload errors.
Alex P: Config snippet I'm planning to add to the edge config (RFC follow-up):
```
edge.adapters.thin_envelope.enabled = false
edge.adapters.thin_envelope.opt_in_routes = ["/v6/legacy", "/api/old-gen"]
edge.adapters.thin_envelope.telemetry_tag = "thin_envelope_v1"
```
Samir K: Nice. If we keep it a small, language-agnostic transform and shield expensive parsing to a separate worker, we can keep latency low.
Alex P: Good point — adapter will be single-pass JSON token rewrite, no full model parsing. Heavy transforms can be offloaded.
Tina M: One more ops ask: make the opt-in flag a tenant-level override so platform teams can opt tenants in early.
Alex P: Will do. I'll post the RFC follow-up with the rollout flag names and the staging playbook. Thanks for the quick checks — will open the PR tonight.
Samir K: lgtm for prototype, interested in the staging numbers.
Jordan L: Thanks — please include the telemetry slices we discussed so we can compare p95/p99 and error rates.
